title: Before the Red Carpet
description: Makeup by Gurvani Kaur for Before the Red Carpet in GOJI. A vintage-inspired beauty and fashion story featuring defined eyes, rich lip colour, satin, and pearls, presented in colour and black-and-white published portraits.
